subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Should ClawSweeper adopt the shared durable queue drainer and sealed authenticated requeue contract, including a hard fail-closed ceiling at 1,000 active commands, as the production repair operating model?
rationale: The exact-head implementation is coherent and prior findings are resolved, but repository history cannot decide the intended mutation-authority and overload-availability policy; those tradeoffs need an accountable maintainer decision.

options.title: Adopt after checks
options.body: Accept the fail-closed ceiling and authenticated requeue model, document overflow recovery, and merge this exact head after required checks pass.

options.title: Require recovery implementation
options.body: Add and prove a bounded operator recovery mechanism before merge if a hard stop at the active-command ceiling is unacceptable.

options.title: Keep current model
options.body: Close or substantially narrow the draft if maintainers do not want the shared queue and authority contract in production.

recommendation.title: Adopt after checks
recommendation.body: Accept the fail-closed ceiling and authenticated requeue model, document overflow recovery, and merge this exact head after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the major repair-lane unification and most central-path history, so he is the best available independent owner for adopting a production automation contract.
